FireRed & LeafGreen

Released September 1, 2004 · 116 cards

FireRed & LeafGreen is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the EX series, released in English on September 1, 2004. Its main set has 112 cards, plus 4 secret rares numbered beyond the set (116 in total). It includes 99 Pokémon, 16 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

28 illustrators worked on FireRed & LeafGreen. Most cards: Ken Sugimori (16), Ryo Ueda (8), Atsuko Nishida (6), Hajime Kusajima (6), Kouki Saitou (6), Midori Harada (6), Hisao Nakamura (5), Kagemaru Himeno (5).
